R344.note: Allowlist gate before require(); summary stays default, matches contract.

R345.note: Wrapping ruleSource in `return (...)` does not sandbox Nashorn - a single expression (e.g. a bare Java.type(...) call, or chained via the comma operator) still reaches Java classes; RCE is unchanged.

R350.note: Allowlist dispatch table replaces the user-controlled function name reaching call_user_func_array.

R352.note: Parameterized CallableStatement with setString binds the header value as data instead of SQL text.

R357.note: Narrow JobRequest DTO decodes only Command/Priority; IsAdmin hardcoded false server-side, matches contract exactly.

R358.note: execFileSync with an argument array plus a digit-only geometry regex removes the shell; neither path argument can start with '-' since both are directory-prefixed.

R359.note: Optional<Long> with orElse(0L) at both call sites matches the contract's 'handle absence explicitly, no discount' requirement precisely.

R360.note: snprintf with dest_size bounds the write and signals overflow via return code; caller clears out and returns instead of overflowing, matches contract.

R361.note: FileInfo/DirectoryInfo FullName containment check after Path.Combine blocks traversal and absolute-path escapes.

R362.note: Restores signature verification with a real secret and pins the HS256 algorithm, closing the alg-confusion angle too.

R364.note: Direct setSecure(true), the correct one-line fix.

R365.note: basename check plus sendFile's root option, the framework-native containment mechanism.

R366.note: Converts GET to POST so CsrfFilter applies, the correct shape for a state-changing safe-method endpoint; the write-up itself notes legitimate callers (the settings-page link) must now submit a token, an acknowledged required client-side follow-up.

R371.note: encode_entities()'s default charset covers <,>,&,'," - sufficient for this HTML text-node context.

R372.note: Parameterized DirContext.search overload with a {0} placeholder; JNDI escapes the bound value per RFC 4515.
